title.narrative: "Comprehensive assistance for vulnerable families in Zaporizka, Donetska, Kharkivska oblasts".

description.narrative: ltpgtProject aimed at providing Comprehensive child protection, GBV and MPC assistance for vulnerable families in Zaporizka, Donetska, Kharkivska oblasts. This assistance will be provided in the form:ltbrgtChild Protection:ltbrgt1. Psycho-social support of vulnerable families (majority of parents/caregivers in such families are women) with children through 96 art-rehabilitation events offline for 1920 children (969 boys and 951 girls) in local communities (32 events in each target oblasts) with participation of a mobile team (psychologist, social worker) with further CP case management for the most vulnerable families, children, including the referral of women to the necessary services of support for GBV survivors, referral to the Child Protection Referral Pathways system and CPIMS+96 offline trainings on FPA, CP. ltbrgt2. 8 trainings online on First psychological aid and stress management that include the referral mechanisms for Child Protection and GBV cases for vulnerable women and men, including women and men with disabilities and specialists who work with children and vulnerable populations (social workers, teachers, the representatives of child protection services, the representatives of the NGOs, volunteers etc.. - they are mostly women).ltbrgt3. 8 trainings online on Child Protection in Humanitarian Actions with focus on Child Protection, Do Not Harm, CP Minimum standards, Sexual exploitation and abuse of children for vulnerable women and men and specialists who work with children and vulnerable populations.ltbrgtGBV: 8 group discussions online on GBV for vulnerable women and men, including women and men with disabilities and specialists who work with children and vulnerable populations. Our staff will use the Pocket Guide GBV in case they will identify the women and girls affected by GBV for referral.ltbrgtMPC: Multipurpose cash assistance (MPC) for target groups for 5950 vulnerable beneficiaries (mostly women and children). ltbrgtWe will publish the info on Referral system on Child Protection and GBV at our web site and train the staff of our call center Referral system on CP and GBV.ltbrgt5) Beneficiaries: vulnerable families in difficult life circumstances: 1) families with children where the parents/caregivers lost their job and there are no state aid and source of income (mostly women-led HH) 2) families with children, especially with disabilities or in the process of proceeding the disability status with no income at this moment (majority of parents/caregiver are women) (Cash for CP) 3) urgent situation (surgery, death of relatives, shelling) 4) staff which work with children – psychologists, social workers, teachers, representatives of local self-government, CSOs, volunteers etc. - they are mostly women. ltbrgtWe will use the flexible approach in targeting the beneficiaries for MPC that allows beneficiaries to solve their problems and meet their urgent multiply needs: through the offline registration in communities and we use individual approach to provide the MPC for the most vulnerable women and men, girls and boys, especially from the locations near the contact line urgently during from 3 to 10 working days through our approach: 1) online form 2) call center 3) e-mail that allow to cover the most vulnerable citizens so they will not wait to be included in the list from community and request directly. Three-month MPC payment 3600 UAH ($100) will be transferred from our bank account to the bank account of beneficiaries. ltbrgtUFF within the project has call-center for providing the consultations, receiving the feedback and online form for feedback. We’ll conduct the permanent monitoring within the project.ltbrgtLocalization: We will have 2 local partner organizations in Donetska and Kharkivska oblasts. We will provide the trainings and security items for strengthening their capacities.ltbrgtWe will train all our staff and staff of the partner organizations on CP, GBV, our PSEA policy, GBV Pocket Guide for usage of this information in their work.ltbrgtlt/pgt
